WHERE campaign_id = ? AND username = ?',\n  );\n  stmt.run(hp_current, status, successes, failures, campaignId, username);\n}\n\nexport function updatePlayMembershipDeathSaves(\n  campaignId: string,\n  username: string,\n  status: PlayMembershipStatus,\n  successes: number,\n  failures: number,\n): void {\n  const db = getDb();\n  const stmt = db.prepare(\n    'UPDATE play_members SET status = ?, death_save_successes = ?, death_save_failures = ? AND item_slug = ? AND owner = ?',\n    )\n    .get(campaignId, itemSlug, owner) as { quantity: number } | undefined;\n  if (!existing) {\n    throw new Error('insufficient quantity');\n  }\n  const newQty = existing.quantity - quantity;\n  if (newQty < 0) {\n    throw new Error('insufficient quantity');\n  }\n  if (newQty === 0) {\n    db.prepare(\n      'DELETE FROM inventory WHERE campaign_id = ? AND item_slug = ? AND owner = ?',\n    ).run(campaignId, itemSlug, owner);\n  } else {\n    db.prepare(\n      'UPDATE inventory SET quantity = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND item_slug = ?
